data.description: Chunky Warcraft-style ancient tree guardian with gnarled root-striding legs, massive moss-draped bark pauldrons, glowing emerald heartwood runes, lantern-hung boughs, and a lush canopy crown.
data.evolution: Built as a complete rigged hero creature in Blizzard/Warcraft style: established a 58-joint skeleton with pelvis/spine, neck/head/jaw/beard, four canopy boughs with hinged druidic lantern and amber sap censer, heroic gorilla-proportioned bark arms with 4 articulated digits per hand, pillar root-legs with 3 root-claw toes per foot planted at y = 0, and a trailing taproot tail; layered hand-painted procedural bark, heartwood, moss, bronze, and canopy paints with custom SVG leaf-cluster and hanging-moss cards plus self-lit emerald/amber runes and eyes.
data.name: Ancient Treant
data.flaws: None known; all geometry is faceted at appropriate segment counts to avoid fine-mesh warnings, all glowing parts use flat colours or textures, and the root-claw feet sit cleanly on y = 0.
